build_cotracker3_offline: build a CoTracker3 offline model with default window length of 16 frames
build_cotracker3_online: build a CoTracker3 online model for real-time point tracking with configurable window length
build_cotracker2: build a CoTracker2 model with stride 4 and a custom window length
load_checkpoint: build a CoTracker model and load pretrained weights from a checkpoint file
review_build_cotracker: review the build_cotracker factory function that constructs CoTracker2 or CoTracker3 models
